Remark
[fundamental group and center of a compact Lie group]

Source: petersen:page-0326 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-structure-theorem 1. ch7:7.5.20Let $G$ be a compact connected Lie group with a biinvariant metric and $\Ric \ge 0$.

  1. If $G$ has finite center, show $\pi _1(G)$ is finite.

  2. Show a finite cover of $G$ has the form $G'\times T^k$ with $G'$ compact simply connected and $T^k$ a torus.

  3. If $\pi _1(G)$ is finite, show the center of $G$ is finite.
